questions.q: What database option enables SQL Server's automatic plan-regression correction?
options: SET AUTOMATIC_TUNING (FORCE_LAST_GOOD_PLAN = ON)
SET QUERY_STORE = ON
SET RECOVERY FULL
SET COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL = 150
questions.explain: AUTOMATIC_TUNING with FORCE_LAST_GOOD_PLAN = ON is the real database option that turns on automatic plan-regression correction.

questions.q: Why does Automatic Tuning require Query Store to already be enabled?
options: It's built directly on top of the plan and runtime-stats history Query Store already captures — without that history there's nothing to compare against
It has no dependency on Query Store at all
Query Store must be disabled for Automatic Tuning to work
Automatic Tuning replaces Query Store entirely
questions.explain: Automatic Tuning's detection logic compares a query's current plan against its own history in Query Store's runtime stats store.

questions.q: How does Automatic Tuning detect a plan regression, per this lesson?
options: It compares a query's current plan's runtime statistics against its own recent history and looks for a statistically significant regression after a plan change
It runs a fixed benchmark test against every query nightly
It relies entirely on DBA-submitted tickets
It only checks CPU usage at the server level, not per query
questions.explain: Detection is data-driven: it's based on comparing the new plan's measured performance against the same query's prior plan performance, both already in Query Store.

questions.q: What happens if Automatic Tuning forces a plan and that doesn't actually help?
options: SQL Server keeps monitoring and can un-force the plan, letting the optimizer try again
The database is automatically taken offline
Nothing — once forced, a plan can never be un-forced
Query Store is automatically disabled
questions.explain: This is a closed loop, not a one-time action — it continues to measure the outcome and reverses course if forcing the old plan didn't help.

questions.q: Where can you see what Automatic Tuning has recommended or done, applied or not?
options: sys.dm_db_tuning_recommendations
sys.dm_os_wait_stats
sys.query_store_runtime_stats_interval
sys.dm_exec_cached_plans
questions.explain: sys.dm_db_tuning_recommendations lists both automatically applied actions and recommendations offered without FORCE_LAST_GOOD_PLAN acting on them.
